rules: Counts are method+instance specific, not number of panels/points in a categorical endpoint plot.
reported SLSQP nit=1 does not disclose a full per-update history; actual_updates is null unless independently established.
An accepted initial state or one update does not demonstrate solver error or geographic area causality.
New Ann numerical science accepted separately from public-derivative rights; two reused baselines are not new experiments.
Original R2, stricter S600/S72, new choice demand stay separate.
Old immutable public records may retain superseded statuses; current acceptance follows later release and current reader.
